blocker_detail: Two standalone pure-prompt tasks completed using the sealed Run A image prompt as the entire saved task prompt, but the available Compiler automation, Gmail-notification, personal-context, Files/Library, and web-access surfaces do not expose the generated task-result image bytes or pixels for automated inspection. The notification exposes only the run-conversation link. No owner retrieval or manual transfer is permitted.
next_retry_condition: A supported zero-cost native mechanism must first prove both programmatic retrieval/inspection of a pure standalone generated image and clean-story-only compatibility with same-invocation exact-byte persistence.
